movement: E.2 changes from OPEN to REFUTED AS STATED. An all-tests construction gives a nonidentity rank-one crystal automorphism invisible to stratifications over an explicit flat finitely presented family; a second version works over regular Fp[t] with noncoherent coefficients. All hypotheses, naturality and nonvanishing were independently audited. The broader requested universal assertion is decided; the narrower manuscript insertion is separately preserved.

A.1 no longer has an undecided unrestricted full coherent injectivity assertion: an explicit smooth sixfold with a very ample degree-one smooth section refutes it in every prime. The integral small-degree assertions, exact intermediate degree list and surface version remain, but the previously open full coherent yes/no gate is closed negatively.

B.3 wild higher torsion is reduced to at most one explicit level for each fixed ramification index, and all full9 cases are now decided: exactly6 divides e and e>=18. The four former indices24,30,42,48 are constructed over explicit finite local fields. The first remaining elliptic case is full27 at e216, a strictly smaller gate than the unrestricted higher-wild range at review01.

A.4 now has a proved exact effective construction of the full geometric and arithmetic matrix images, beyond review01's determinant-only general calculation. The actual nonabelian images on one fixed ordinary product surface are also proved in degrees1 and2, including the full translation subgroup in degree2. Uniform structural classification and higher product degrees remain expressly open.

B.4's lower bound at p2,e1,height>=2 is sharpened from failure at manuscript level0 to failure even at level1 via the exactly checked full4-torsion counterexample. The least index must therefore be at least2 in this family; the general exact least index remains open.
